author: Warhammer
description:
Amidst the ranks of the Lumineth infantry, a Vanari Lord Regent is a powerful and inspiring presence. This is emphasised through its miniature, which is deserving of a magnificent paint job! Tune in to this video as Ollie shows you everything you need to know about painting this epic hero. 

Here’s a list of the paints we used in today’s video:

Base:
Corax White
Leadbelcher
Macragge Blue
Mephiston Red
Retributor Armour
Rhinox Hide
Wraithbone

Layer:
Alaitoc Blue
Dark Reaper
Dechala Lilac
Fenrisian Grey
Gorthor Brown
Hoeth Blue
Kislev Flesh
Liberator Gold
Loren Forest
Lothern Blue
Screaming Skull
Stormhost Silver
Stormvermin Fur
Teclis Blue
Ushabti Bone
White Scar

Contrast:
Frostheart
Gore-grunta Fur

Shade:
Nuln Oil
Reikland Fleshshade

Technical:
Lahmian Medium
Stirland Mud

Brushes:
M Base
S Layer
M Layer
M Shade
S Dry

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.

Follow for more Warhammer, more often
title: How to Paint a Vanari Lord Regent | Warhammer Age of Sigmar
